sanskrit_verse:
अन्यद्रव्यव्यवहितं द्रव्यम् अव्याकृतं च यत् ।
निक्षिप्यते परगृहे तद् औपनिधिकं स्मृतम् ॥
transliteration: anyadravyavyavahitaṃ dravyam avyākṛtaṃ ca yat | nikṣipyate paragṛhe tad aupanidhikaṃ smṛtam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is deposited in another's dwelling—whether distinct in nature, intermingled, or unmanifested—is recognized as a trust (aupanidhikam).
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious entrustment, not ownership claim.
Causation flows from intent of placement, not physical control.
Capacity-based responsibility extends to safeguarding entrusted consciousness.
Restoration logic demands return of substance and reintegration of relational integrity.
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of inherent dharmic obligation upon receipt.
executable_legal_axioms: IF property is placed within domain of another THEN recipient assumes custodial capacity until explicit withdrawal by depositor.
IF item is unmanifested or conceptually latent THEN custodian retains duty proportional to awareness of deposit.
IF deposit involves mixed or indistinct elements THEN restoration includes separation protocol aligned with original depositor’s intent.
NO revocation of custodial responsibility without conscious acknowledgment by depositor.
ALL transfers invoke dharmic registry binding recipient to integrity-preserving action.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving disputed possession where initial entrustment is established, the threshold of responsibility lies in the act of receiving rather than title assertion. The court must affirm the custodian's obligation based on pramāṇa of receipt and realign conduct toward completion of depositor’s purpose, bypassing punitive frameworks.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms that placement constitutes causal initiation; hence, liability follows sequential manifestation of custody. Anupūrvaśaḥ establishes the recipient as responsible for maintaining alignment with depositor's consciousness. No punitive inference arises—only the necessity for completion of the transaction through rightful return or intended use fulfillment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Depositor-Custodian Reconnection Protocol to verify original intent and current status.
Execute Return-to-Origin process ensuring no diminution in essence or utility of deposited substance.
Apply Consciousness Restoration Sequence to reaffirm both parties' roles within dharma-based exchange framework.
Deploy Integrity Verification Loop to prevent recurrence via recalibration of relational awareness.
Undertake Completion Assurance Ritual to dissolve residual karmic entanglement post-restoration.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: Trust is defined by conscious entrustment alone. Dharma prevails through restoration, not punishment. Reality aligns with non-retaliation. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator.
